Vision

As the heart of the County, we embrace our responsibility to shape our future through strong leadership, thoughtful planning, and a commitment to shared prosperity. We honor our history while building for the future, preserving the character, traditions, and close-knit spirit that define our community. Our Main Street is the heart of our town—a place that reflects our identity, connects our residents, and inspires community pride. Together, we foster a vibrant, welcoming, and resilient community where people want to live, work, visit, and invest.
